title: Live-stream compatibility and function/tool-call fidelity verification for newly onboarded models
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Context: As part of the model onboarding pipeline we must ensure that every model snapshot that is published with a streaming profile and function/tool-call support behaves correctly in the hosted and dedicated runtimes. This ticket covers a focused verification pass for streaming semantics, function/tool-call handshake correctness, and the fidelity of chunked output when pinned to versions published in the model catalog. Goals: 1) Automate a set of end-to-end scenarios that exercise streaming + tool/function calls against newly onboarded model snapshots. 2) Validate behavioral equivalence between streaming and non-streaming code paths (where applicable). 3) Measure latency and token-fidelity regressions and publish a structured performance report to the model catalog entry so PMs and ML engineers can decide promotion or rollback. Constraints: tests must run against snapshots in the onboarding staging bucket, tolerate model-specific chunking heuristics, and integrate with the existing profiling/metrics pipeline (Datadog dashboards + model-catalog metadata). This work should not change runtime behavior in production; it is purely verification and reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Verification harness runs >= 120 end-to-end scenarios (streaming + tool-calls) across 4 recent model snapshots and produces pass/fail per scenario
For each scenario, compare final structured function arguments and ensure 100% agreement between streaming-assembled and non-streaming responses (or documented acceptable diffs with reason)
Latency SLO checks: median tail-latency delta between current and baseline model snapshot < 15% for streaming path under CI load profile
Artifacts: generated JSON report is posted to the model-catalog entry with a human-readable summary and machine-readable fields for automation (status: pass/warn/fail)
Blocking rule: any scenario that fails function-call argument reconstruction or produces malformed JSON in streamed chunks must mark the snapshot as 'hold for investigation' in the onboarding UI

Smoke test must exercise graceful fallback: if streaming concat fails, runtime should log and re-run non-streaming path; the harness verifies fallback occurred and resulting response preserved required fields
tasks: Extend existing onboarding harness to add streaming function-call scenarios (prompt templates, tool-spec stubs, latency probes)
Implement chunk-boundary fuzzing to catch off-by-one token splits and abbreviation artifacts and add to regression set
Add token-level trace capture for streaming sessions and normalize traces to compare against non-streaming snapshots
Wire harness to publish pass/fail and per-scenario metrics to the model catalog API (include links to perf graphs)
Create a dashboard tile (Datadog) for automated CI runs summarizing pass rate and tail-latency deltas
Write a short on-call playbook entry describing actions when a model snapshot is held by this check
comments: 2026-02-21 Aisha Khan: Initial spike completed. Baseline harness exists for non-streaming function-call verification. Observed two classes of mismatch when replaying streaming output: (1) chunked JSON framing that splits arrays across chunks, (2) tokenization-induced whitespace differences. Will add normalization and chunk reassembly layer.

2026-02-25 Liam O'Connor: Added chunk-boundary reassembly prototype and fuzz harness. On local runs, prototype fixed several false-positives but introduced 40-60ms extra reassembly CPU per session—will measure at scale before enabling by default.

2026-03-03 Review (PM): Sofia Martinez: PM review - acceptance criteria look good. Request to ensure model-catalog report includes explicit 'promotion-recommendation' and 'rollback-reason' fields. Added as follow-up task.

2026-03-05 Eng review: Rajiv Patel reviewed PR and requested clearer separation between verification-only metrics and user-facing catalog metadata. Updated PR to publish machine-readable 'verification' object separate from human summary.

2026-03-09 CI run: 4 snapshots x 30 scenarios run in staging. Results: 112/120 pass, 6 warn (minor whitespace diffs), 2 fail (both due to chunk-split in tool-arg array). Filed ENG-55202 to triage the two failing snapshots with model owners.
2026-03-10 Liam O'Connor: Pushed new dashboard tile; catalog publishing uses signed URL for artifacts. Next step: hook into version-pinning workflow to block promotion when verification fails.
notes: Decision: don't attempt model code-path changes here; keep fixes to harness and runtime fallbacks only
Trade-off: enabling chunk reassembly in the runtime reduces per-request p99 by ~3-5% in microbenchmarks; prefer harness-level reassembly for now
Follow-up: ENG-55202 created to contact model owners for the two failing snapshots; ENG-55300 proposed to add automatic rollback automation in the catalog
